references.text: Moses refers to the Lord's self-revelation where He declared His character as merciful, gracious, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness.
The following verse quotes the words Moses referred to, where the Lord's power is manifested in His patience and great mercy.
An earlier intercession by Moses where he appeals to God's honor and promises to avert God's wrath against the people.
Moses' intercession where he reminds God of His power and mighty hand that brought the people out of Egypt.
The psalmist asks that the greatness of God's arm may be revealed, similar to Moses' prayer that the Lord's power may be made great.
Refers to Moses who stood in the gap for the people and asked God not to destroy them, as He does here.
